This backfill found and fixed a real WCAG 2 AA contrast defect: $kbd-color/$kbd-bg previously resolved to var(--bs-secondary-color) on var(--bs-secondary-bg), which axe measured at 4.07:1 (light) and 4.48:1 (dark) against the 4.5:1 minimum for normal text. They now use Bootstrap's own var(--bs-secondary-text-emphasis) / var(--bs-secondary-bg-subtle) pair, already used by Alert and List Group, which is accessible by construction.

This backfill found and fixed two real defects in the disabled prev/next nav item: aria-label is not a permitted attribute on a bare span with no role (axe aria-prohibited-attr), and the disabled span carried no aria-disabled marker, so axe's disabled-widget exemption could not apply and flagged the intentionally muted disabled text as a normal-text contrast failure. The disabled branch now renders role="link" aria-disabled="true" alongside aria-label. The numbered pagination_item's disabled span also gained aria-disabled="true" for the same reason.
